headline: Argentina Senate Approves Bill Suspending PASO Primary Elections
summary: Argentina's Senate approved a political reform bill promoted by Javier Milei's government that suspends open, simultaneous, and mandatory primary elections ahead of the 2027 presidential vote.
why: Legislative reforms regarding electoral processes alter the political timeline and campaign spending dynamics in national elections.
